$comment: S4-C battery: /out disk exhaustion. Per god ruling /out is a per-run HOST BIND with du-watchdog kill-on-breach (not tmpfs ENOSPC). Per pam schema note @8f9487b: du-watchdog breach surfaces on the timedOut path (SIGTERM->grace->SIGKILL) => assert timedOut:true + logsTail evidence; artifacts survive teardown in host dir.
mechanism: du-watchdog polls diskMb budget, terminates run, marks failure

cmd: dd if=/dev/zero of=/out/blob bs=1M count=512 2>/dev/null; echo wrote-$(du -m /out/blob | cut -f1)MB

env.WORKER_OUT_DU_POLL_MS_HINT: runner-level knob set by harness to 1000
